title: write_schema
description: Write the registry. op=extend adds one row as origin='extension' (idempotent; 409 if it exists as canonical). op=merge bulk-writes owner-approved entries as origin='canonical'.

op.description: extend: one extension row + the registry.extended event. merge: bulk canonical write.

registry.description: Which canonical registry. read_schema with source=canonical and no registry lists them.

bucket.description: extend only, required there. Registry-specific path. chart_of_accounts: 'asset' | 'liability' | 'equity' | 'revenue' | 'expense'. contact_fields: 'common' | 'vendor' | 'customer' | 'employee'.

name.description: extend only, required there. Entry identifier within the bucket. UPPER_SNAKE for chart_of_accounts (e.g. TIPS_REVENUE); snake_case for fields registries (e.g. loyalty_tier).

schema.description: extend only, required there. Registry-specific shape value. chart_of_accounts: pass true (presence is the schema). Fields registries: object with type/required/description and a `class` (economic | operational | subject | secret).

reason.description: extend only, required there. Why this entry is needed. The operator agent clusters by reason text when deciding what to promote.

entries.description: merge only, required there. Entries to write; each row is keyed by (registry, bucket#name) and pre-existing rows at the same key are overwritten.

schema.description: Registry-specific shape value. true for chart_of_accounts; object for fields registries.
